sn19.21:1.1: idhāhaṃ āvuso gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ sāmaṇeriṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ
sn19.21:1.2: tassā saṅghāṭipi ādittā sampajjalitā sañjotibhūtā pattopi āditto sampajjalito sañjotibhūto kāya bandhanampi ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sañjotibhūtaṃ kāyopi āditto sampajjalito sañjotibhūto
sn19.21:1.5: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhūtaṃ vata bho
sn19.21:2.3: ñāṇabhūtā vata bhikkhave sāvakā viharanti yatra hi nāma sāvako evarūpaṃ ñassati vā dakkhati vā sakkhiṃ vā karissati.
sn19.21:2.4: pubbeva me sā bhikkhave sāmaṇerī diṭṭhā ahosi.
sn19.21:2.6: ahañcetaṃ byākareyyaṃ parepi me na saddaheyyuṃ
sn19.21:2.7: ye me na saddaheyyuṃ tesaṃ taṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
sn19.21:2.8: esā bhikkhave sāmaṇerī kassapassa sammā sambuddhassa pāvacane pāpasāmaṇerī ahosi
sn19.21:2.9: sā tassa kammassa vipākena bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni bahūni vassasatasahassāni niraye pacittha tasseva kammassa vipākāvasesena evarūpaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvedayatīti.
